prompt:
You are given {n_clauses} clauses from a US consumer-finance company's internal compliance policy manual. Each clause has a clause id (like K0001) and was written to implement exactly one paragraph of the federal regulations in an offline library of {n_parts} parts of the Code of Federal Regulations, covering consumer credit, electronic fund transfers, privacy notices, credit reporting, mortgage servicing, deposit accounts, children's online privacy, information security, identity theft and anti-money-laundering rules. The clauses never name the regulation or its numbers.

For each clause, cite the regulation paragraph it implements: the section number and the first-level paragraph letter, written like "12 CFR 1024.35(e)". A more specific citation inside that paragraph, like "12 CFR 1024.35(e)(1)", is also accepted. A citation without a paragraph letter, or to the wrong paragraph of the right section, is wrong.

Be careful: several regulations contain parallel provisions with similar wording — for example, different notices, different kinds of disputes or requests, or different account types. They differ in details such as deadlines, dollar amounts, who must act and under what conditions, so check each clause's details against the regulation text before deciding.

The library is the only source; there is no internet access.

Tools: list_clauses pages through the clauses with offset and limit; list_sections shows the table of contents (every section's citation and heading, optionally for one part); read_section reads a section's paragraphs with their designations, from a start paragraph; search runs a keyword search over all paragraphs and returns paragraph citations with the start of their text. A good approach is to scan the table of contents, use keyword search to find candidate paragraphs, then read the candidate sections to confirm the details.

Final answer: one JSON object mapping every clause id to its citation, for example {"K0001": "12 CFR 1024.35(e)", "K0002": "16 CFR 314.4(c)"}. Clauses that are missing count as wrong.
tool_list_clauses: Page through the policy clauses using offset and limit parameters. Returns a batch of clauses with their clause ids and text.
tool_list_sections: Show the regulation library's table of contents: every section's citation and heading. Can optionally be restricted to one part.
tool_read_section: Read a section's paragraphs with their designations, starting from a given start paragraph. Use it to verify the full text of candidate paragraphs.
tool_search: Keyword search over all paragraphs in the library. Returns paragraph citations with the start of their text.
